name: DeleteAuthorizationRules

parameters.help_en: List of authorization rule IDs. You can specify up to 200 authorization rule IDs
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则ID列表。最多支持传入200个授权规则ID
parameters.name: authorization_rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
Ensures idempotence of the request.
Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。
从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without updating the authorization rules. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are exceeded. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the authorization rules are updated immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新授权规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接更新授权规则
parameters.name: dry_run
